summary: The desktop composer's round Stop and Send buttons move inside the input box at its bottom-right, with the same inset from the box's right and bottom edges; the box is 42px on one line, so they are centred on a one-line draft and stay in the corner as the draft grows. Text and placeholder reserve room for them, and a tall draft's scrollbar ends above them. The context-window ring is the footer's last item, centred under the Send button, and stays right-aligned when a narrow footer wraps it onto its own row.

reactNativeIos.reason: apps/mobile has its own composer and send button layout, which this change does not touch.

nativeAndroid.reason: The Compose composer is its own layout; nothing it renders is affected.

sharedBackendApi.reason: Renderer layout only. The one main-process change is the scripted demo adapter (SB_DEMO_ADAPTER=1, screenshots and tour only) reporting a context_window event so the ring shows in the screenshots; no real adapter or wire contract changes.

updateRelease.reason: An unconditional desktop renderer fix with no flag, package identity, signing, update-channel or rollout change.

automated: SB_VISUAL_SCOPE=screens npm run test:e2e:visual (composer-running, approval, queued-message, chat, chat-narrow, confirm-dialog in Dark, Light and Translucent)
notExercised: The tall multi-line draft and the dual chat panel were measured with a one-off Playwright probe against the built app (equal 9.6px right and bottom inset, ring centre on the Send centre), not by a committed test.
